targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value_cpu_utilization_properties_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["thingId"] =~ /hnguyen\.clustertwin:node_/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "cpu")

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value_avg_cpu_utilization_properties_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["thingId"] =~ /hnguyen\.clustertwin:rack_/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "rack_cpu")

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value_avg_cpu_utilization_properties_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["thingId"] == "hnguyen.clustertwin:main_cluster")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "cluster_cpu")

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -2m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value_cpu_utilization_properties_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["thingId"] =~ /hnguyen\.clustertwin:node_/)
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["thingId", "_value", "parent"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "CPU %", thingId: "Node", parent: "Rack"})
  |> sort(columns: ["CPU %"], desc: true)

panels.title: Current node state (sorted by CPU descending)
